testing.ifa

Testing Tutorial

Learn how to write effective tests for your Ifá-Lang programs.

Assertions with Okanran.beeni

The Okanran.beeni (or English alias assert) method checks conditions at runtime:

// Basic assertions
ayanmo result = Okanran.beeni(2 + 2 == 4, "Math works");
Irosu.fo(result);  // Assertion passes

ayanmo result = Okanran.beeni(Ika.len("hello") == 5, "Length check");

// English alias
ayanmo result = Okanran.beeni(total > 0, "Total must be positive");

Test Functions

Organize tests in functions with descriptive names:

// test_math.ifa

ese test_addition() {
    ayanmo r1 = Okanran.beeni(2 + 2 == 4, "2+2=4");
    ayanmo r2 = Okanran.beeni(-1 + 1 == 0, "-1+1=0");
    Irosu.fo("test_addition passed");
}

ese test_subtraction() {
    ayanmo r1 = Okanran.beeni(5 - 3 == 2, "5-3=2");
    ayanmo r2 = Okanran.beeni(0 - 1 == -1, "0-1=-1");
    Irosu.fo("test_subtraction passed");
}

// Run all tests
test_addition();
test_subtraction();
Irosu.fo("All tests passed!");

Running Tests

# Run a single test file
ifa run tests/test_math.ifa

# Run all tests in directory
ifa test tests/

# Run with verbose output
ifa test --verbose tests/

Testing Errors

Test that code properly handles errors:

ese test_error_handling() {
    // Use Okanran.gbiyanju to catch errors
    ayanmo result = Okanran.gbiyanju({
        -> 10 / 0  // This would be a division error
    }, ofifo);

    // Test error message
    ayanmo is_err = Okanran.beeni(result == ofifo, "Division by zero should return default");
    
    Irosu.fo("test_error_handling passed");
}

Test Fixtures

Set up test data before tests:

ese setup_test_data() {
    padapo {
        "users": [
            {"id": 1, "name": "Alice"},
            {"id": 2, "name": "Bob"}
        ],
        "products": [
            {"sku": "A001", "price": 100}
        ]
    };
}

ese test_user_lookup() {
    ayanmo data = setup_test_data();
    ayanmo users = Ogunda.wa(data["users"], { u -> u["id"] == 1 });
    
    ayanmo r1 = Okanran.beeni(users != ofifo, "User found");
    Irosu.fo("test_user_lookup passed");
}

Testing File I/O

ese test_file_operations() {
    ayanmo test_file = "test_output.txt";
    
    // Write
    Odi.ko(test_file, "Hello, World!");
    ayanmo r1 = Okanran.beeni(Odi.wa(test_file), "File exists");
    
    // Read
    ayanmo content = Odi.ka(test_file);
    ayanmo r2 = Okanran.beeni(content == "Hello, World!", "Content matches");
    
    // Cleanup
    Odi.pa_faili(test_file);
    ayanmo r3 = Okanran.beeni(!Odi.wa(test_file), "File deleted");
    
    Irosu.fo("test_file_operations passed");
}

Best Practices

  • One assertion per concept - Test one thing at a time
  • Descriptive names - test_user_login_with_invalid_password_fails
  • Cleanup after tests - Delete test files, reset state
  • Test edge cases - Empty lists, nil values, large numbers
  • Use Babalawo - Catch issues before runtime
